key_insight: Tightly coupling multi-view reconstruction with a strong generative 3D prior and performing conditional generation on overlapping, spatially-localized chunks yields high-fidelity, complete 3D scene reconstructions that scale to large environments.
problem_solved: Addresses incomplete, noisy, or low-detail multi-view 3D reconstruction and the difficulty of scaling high-quality generative priors to large scenes while preserving local detail and global consistency.
method: Tile the scene into spatially-localized, overlapping chunks that together cover the scene extent.
Condition a state-of-the-art generative 3D model (e.g., Trellis.2) on multi-view RGB evidence to generate each chunk with high fidelity and completeness.
Merge and reconcile overlapping chunks to produce a coherent global reconstruction with preserved fine detail and reduced artifacts.
impact: Enables practitioners to leverage powerful generative priors for practical, large-scale multi-view reconstruction pipelines, improving completeness and detail for applications like AR/VR, robotics, and digital twins with fewer views or noisy inputs.
